about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Version 2 candidate = the shipped version 1 (its three trigger rules and its thirteen cast rules unchanged and in their order; no attack block, so Forge attacks, as shipped) plus seven cast rules for the deck's answers: rules 2 to 5 at the top (after Sol Ring, before Cloud) and rules 11 to 13 before the shipped creature rule. Written from the 200 games of the league of twelve (league-run #3, seed 20261250), where the seat won 35 and lost 165. On its last own turn of a loss the seat had 3 creatures (median) against 11 for the widest opponent; an opponent had 5 or more creatures and more than the seat in 144 of the 165 losses and 7 of the 35 wins (7 or more: 124 and 6). Drawn / cast / in hand on the last own turn of a loss: Vanquish the Horde 55/29/18, Austere Command 45/14/22, Ultimate Magic: Meteor 42/0/5 (Forge foretells it, 49 times hand to exile, and never casts it from exile), Decimate 55/21/26, Summon: Kujata 50/22/22, Yuffie, Materia Hunter 32/0/21, Dispatch 50/0/32, Clever Concealment 43/0/30; Chaos Warp 51/47, Cloud's Limit Break 50/50, Vandalblast 55/44 and Ultimate Magic: Holy 43/25 are cast by Forge already and are left to it. RULE 3, the wipe: Vanquish the Horde, else Meteor (hard cast from hand), when an opponent has 5 or more creatures, more power than we have and more creatures than we have. Both kill our creatures too; the equipment, which is this deck, stays, and Cloud comes back from the command zone (rule 6 sits below, so he is recast after the wipe). 5 rather than 7: on the losses' last turns 5 adds 20 losses and 1 win to the 7 condition. RULE 4, the emergency: the same two when an opponent could kill us next turn with more power than ours, whatever the count. RULE 5 holds the two from Forge: of Forge's 43 league casts of Vanquish and Austere, 8 were outside the rule-3 board (6 losses, 2 wins). RULE 2: Ultimate Magic: Holy first (our permanents indestructible until end of turn) when a wipe of rule 3 is in hand, rule 3's board holds, we have 2 creatures or more and 9 mana; the wipe then follows. Never seen to fire locally: Forge foretells Holy within a turn or two of drawing it, and a foretold card cannot be cast by a rule. RULE 11, Decimate moved ahead of the creatures (Forge picks the four targets; the rule only asks earlier). RULE 12, Summon: Kujata when an opponent has 2 creatures (chapter I: 3 damage to up to two creatures, aimed by Forge). RULE 13, Yuffie, Materia Hunter (gain control of an opponent's noncreature artifact; stock Forge never cast her in 32 draws). Tried and dropped: Austere Command in rules 3 to 5. Cast by a play rule it resolves with no mode chosen and destroys nothing (a local game, turn 24: 13 opposing creatures, nothing left the battlefield); Forge's own casts choose modes and destroyed 5 to 35 opposing permanents in the league. It stays Forge's. Dispatch with a play rule (opp_power >= 4): Forge's logic for it (AI:RemoveDeck:All) never agreed in 8 games with it in hand on many turns; dropped. Local tables (24 at seed 20263020 to 20263022, bots-v2, opponents under their playbooks; 3 wins, too few to mean anything): Vanquish cast once (7 opposing creatures against 1), held once correctly when the seat had the widest board and went on to win; Meteor hard-cast twice (7 opposing creatures for 2 of ours plus a Treasure; 13 opposing permanents for Cloud); Kujata 4 casts, 2 creatures each; Yuffie 11 casts (Arcane Signet, Mind Stone, Talisman, Nevinyrral's Disk); Decimate 4 casts.
